title: Pairing bound for a normalized n-vector: Σ_β w(dx^β)² = 1 implies |w(θ)| ≤ Σ_β |θ(e_β)| (Step 4(b) of the parent proof)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let w ∈ NVector (Eucl P) n be an n-vector on ℝ^P (a continuous linear functional on Covector (Eucl P) n) and let θ ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n be an n-covector. Assume Σ_{β ∈ I(n,P)} w(dx^β)² = 1, where I(n,P) = SimonMultiIndex n P, dx^β := wedgeCovectors n (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (β j)) and w(dx^β) = euclideanNVectorCoordinate w β. Then |w(θ)| ≤ Σ_{β ∈ I(n,P)} |θ(e_β)|, where θ(e_β) := euclideanCovectorCoordinate θ β = θ(e_{β(0)}, …, e_{β(n−1)}) and e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n) (θ : Covector (Eucl P) n), ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate w β) ^ 2 = 1 → |w θ| ≤ ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex n P, |euclideanCovectorCoordinate θ β|
